text:
maria: Quick async — onboarding Llama3-Q small-quant (v1.2). Smoke generation finished overnight. Baseline evals look okay but two regression alerts on the SD-promptset (hallucination + truncation).

aj: Nice. can you paste the failing examples?

maria: Sure — short ones below. ```INPUT: 'Summarize the refund policy.' GOLD: 'Refunds issued within 30 days...' PRED: 'No refunds after 14 days unless...'``` One other example where the output cuts off mid-sentence with long context.

lee: That truncation smells like a KV-cache mismatch or a batching edge-case; did you run with the same kv flags as the model card recommends?

maria: I ran with --kv-cache=true and default batcher. Re-ran with kv-refresh=on and still see truncation on contexts >6k tokens.

sophia: Could also be tokenization mismatches — are we using sentencepiece v1 vs v2? Model card for Llama3-Q indicates spm-v2.

maria: Good call. My tokenizer binary in the smoke container was spm-v1 from an older image. Rebuilding tokenizer now and will rerun.

aj: If tokenizer is off, that could explain hallucination alignment too. I'm pinging @eval-bot to rerun the promptset after the rebuild.

eval-bot: queued rerun for thread 2045004321 — scheduling on dedicated gpu-x1; will post a short summary when finished.

maria: Blockers: need a quick CR on two small prompt instructions (clarify 'context scope' and 'summarization length') and permission to run the dedicated eval (cost OK per current budget).

lee: I can review promptset in the next hour. Granting eval quota — go ahead and push when ready.

sophia: Ops question for eng-ml: should we add a canary fallback policy from llama3-q -> llama3-std for requests with prefix length >6k? That would reduce production truncation risk while we debug.

maria: Good idea. For short-term I'll add a rollout policy that falls back on long-context errors. I'll open a tiny PR titled "fallback: long-context -> llama3-std" and link it here.

aj: Also saw a slight latency bump on q-quant when sequence length >4k in the console; filing infra ticket for kernel selection behavior.

maria: Today: finish tokenizer rebuild, push promptset PR, trigger eval rerun, and open fallback PR. Please ping if you want to pair on prompt wording.

sophia: :thumbsup:
